toc.prompt_intro:
The 'AI Format' button is used when the book lacks a scanned table of contents. Paste the unformatted text into the box, and it will intelligently convert it to the target format.

Alternatively, you can use the following prompt to generate the formatted text yourself:

1 Food Categories I Love 1
2 Fruits 2
2.1 Strawberry 3

Reformat the table of contents below into the target format and remove unnecessary comments 

${YOUR_TOCS_COPY_FROM_ANYWHERE}
toc.nav_hint: Use up and down arrow keys for quick navigation

1. Please load your PDF first
2. Drag to select the ToC page range
3. Click the Generate ToC button above

seo.why_desc: PageAtlas turns PDF structure and understanding into one workflow: generate or edit ToCs, ask grounded page and chapter questions, use multimodal reading for scanned pages, and map concepts with an AI knowledge board.
seo.feature_1_desc: Ask precise page-level or chapter-level questions with citations back to the source PDF.
seo.feature_2_desc: Generate and refine bookmarks, then ask questions over text pages and image-only pages with multimodal models.
seo.feature_3_desc: Turn a document outline into a relationship graph for faster exploration and review.
seo.how_title: How to Work with a PDF in PageAtlas
seo.how_step_1: Upload your PDF and let PageAtlas detect whether it already has a ToC.
seo.how_step_2: Choose between ToC generation, page Q&A, or chapter Q&A.
seo.how_step_3: Use multimodal questions for scanned pages and ask by page or by chapter.
seo.how_step_4: Preview, refine, and export the improved PDF workflow.
seo.faq_1_a: Yes, PageAtlas is completely free to use.
seo.faq_2_a: Yes. We process files locally using your browser's capabilities. Your confidential documents never leave your device.
seo.faq_3_a:
PageAtlas supports multiple models. You need to Bring Your Own API Keys.

Currently supported:
• Gemini: Get Key
• Qwen: Get Key
• Doubao: Get Key
• Zhipu: Get Key
• OpenAI Compatible: configure your own Base URL, API Key, and text / vision models.
seo.faq_4_q: Can PageAtlas Lite run fully in the browser?
seo.faq_4_a: Yes. PageAtlas Lite is a browser-only static app that can be deployed to GitHub Pages. AI calls are made directly from the browser using your own API key.
seo.faq_5_a:
• Ctrl/Cmd + Z: Undo
• Ctrl/Cmd + Shift + Z: Redo
• Up/Down Arrows: Quickly switch navigation input
• Mouse Drag: Drag TOC items / groups
